meta.notes: A jigsaw structure starts with a piece from start_pool and attaches more pieces up to size jigsaw steps away (1 here: just the tower). biomes is a biome or biome tag where it may start, and step is the generation step it is placed in. It generates only once a structure set lists it; add one to see it in new chunks. With a set in place, /locate structure msm_examples:lone_tower finds it.
